units.source_text: 可是，他們的不幸可以名正言順地向世人發出抗議，而且「世人」也很容易接受和同情他們的抗議。

en.t: But their unhappiness can make a legitimate protest to the world, and the world is also quick to accept and sympathize with that protest.

units.source_text: 但我的不幸全部源於自身的罪惡，無法向任何人抗議，

en.t: But my own unhappiness comes entirely from my own sins, so I cannot protest to anyone.

units.source_text: 如若我吞吞吐吐說出一句類似於抗議的話，

en.t: If I were to stammer out even a single word that sounded like a protest,

units.source_text: 不僅只是比目魚，肯定所有的世人都會對我的話驚訝得無言以對。

en.t: Not only Hirame, but surely everyone in the world would be so astonished by my words that they would be speechless.

units.source_text: 我真的是俗話裡所說的為所欲為的任性，還是完全相反的過於唯唯諾諾了呢？

en.t: Am I really, as people say, a selfish person who does whatever he wants, or am I the complete opposite, far too timid?

units.source_text: 這一點我自己也搞不明白。

en.t: I do not understand that myself either.

units.source_text: 總之，我是罪惡的綜合體，只會變得越來越不幸，沒有加以防範的具體對策。

en.t: In any case, I am a compound of sin, destined only to become more and more unhappy, with no concrete way to guard against it.
